TITLE: Wide-Energy Plasma
DESCRIPTION: Internal renderer-test archetype (L complexity). A multi-octave plasma whose warp is driven by a crest-factor split of chroma_AudioPeak against chroma_AudioRMS, with a full eight-band chroma_AudioFFT spectral tint and a syn_BPM-locked bloom. Exercises the WIDE-DYNAMIC edge case: the image must stay legible across the entire RMS/peak range -- a calm lit plasma at silence (RMS=peak=0, FFT all 0, syn_BPM=120), readable mid-energy detail, and a saturating-but-not-blown response at full-scale -- via soft-compressed (log-style) energy mappings rather than raw-absolute gain. Single-pass, self-contained, sane and finite under silence. Not shipped in the library bundle.
